metric_definitions.agent_failure_behavior: Synthetic unavailable-agent scenarios routed to their documented safe degradation decision.
metric_definitions.average_response_latency_ms: Mean local end-to-end component latency per successfully evaluated case.
metric_definitions.component_error_rate: Cases that raised an exception in any evaluated local component.
metric_definitions.critical_risk_false_positive_rate: Labelled non-critical cases incorrectly marked CRITICAL by GUARDIAN.
metric_definitions.critical_risk_recall: Labelled critical-risk cases blocked by GUARDIAN's CRITICAL deterministic result.
metric_definitions.escalation_precision: Predicted escalations whose labels require escalation.
metric_definitions.frustration_recall: Frustrated-category cases classified with FRUSTRATED emotion.
metric_definitions.grounded_answer_accuracy: Safe-grounded cases with retrieved expected evidence and claim-level supported output.
metric_definitions.retrieval_hit_rate: Cases with expected evidence where at least one expected document was retrieved.
metric_definitions.unsupported_answer_rejection_rate: Unsupported cases producing insufficient-data or a non-approval routing decision.
metric_definitions.urgent_fraud_recall: Urgent-fraud cases assigned urgency at least 9 or urgent review.
